about_the_game:
Reclaim your homeland with the ultimate guardian - a walking, shooting, and punching Fort! Equip your Fort with 12 upgradeable towers and wreck your enemies across 28 hand-drawn levels.



In this twisted arcade/shoot 'em up you will:
  • Decimate hordes of over 100 smash-able enemy types
  • Use the destructible environment to your advantage (throw a bus, or pick up a tree, or collapse a building or...)
  • Boost your Fort's abilities by building and upgrading towers, customizing your playstyle
  • Dismantle 12 challenging bosses and free your people from their grasp
  • Punch, kick, eye-laser, eat, stomp and smack ANYTHING that tries to stop you
  • See your Fort grow and become more powerful with every patch of liberated land



Oh, and if you manage to catch a break from the mayhem, there is also the story of the world you are saving and an original industrial synthwave soundtrack.

short_description: Take your Fort for a walk, build a bunch of towers and destroy your enemies! This shoot ‘em up arcade lets you be the giant that smashes hordes of tiny foes! Besides shooting, you can punch, kick, eat and eye-laser everything in your way. Destructible environments, hand-drawn art and destruction await!
